correctness.rationale: The cat base A=[[2,1],[1,1]] obeys |det(A-I)|=1 and |det(A^2-I)|=5: precisely two primitive base two-cycles plus the fixed origin. Over base j, the two-step SU(1,1) Möbius matrix has half-trace h_j=[cos(2pi omega)+epsilon^2 cos(2pi mu sigma_j)]/(1-epsilon^2), strictly decreases with omega in (0,1/2). Its h=+/-1 thresholds are L_j=asin(epsilon cos u_j)/pi and U_j=1/2-asin(epsilon sin u_j)/pi; hyperbolic/parabolic/elliptic return contributes 2/1/0 circle fixed points. The off-diagonal matrix factor and 0<mu<1/2 rule out identity returns at threshold. The fiber over the fixed base point has no primitive period-two because its one-step SU(1,1) trace is positive. The ordering of L_L and U_H changes at epsilon*=[cos²u_L+sin²u_H]^{-1/2}; direct arcsin differentiation yields positive transverse crossing. Independently reconstructed base determinants and tested epsilon* ordering for mu=.04,.3,.48. Note at crossover two isolated parabolic two-cycles remain, not a circle. Domain endpoints are explicitly excluded.

value.rationale: A complete primitive-period-two classification in a concrete hyperbolic-base Möbius skew map goes beyond numerical bifurcation plots: it gives all four exact threshold curves, actual endpoint multiplicities, and a sharp phase transition from extinction to reentry of four coexisting cycles. This is a nontrivial natural finite-period dynamical invariant and does not purport to settle a global chaotic attractor collision.
